stories.story_fr: Au T4 et sur l'exercice 2025, EPAM met en avant la montee en puissance et l'acceleration de ses revenus AI-native, positionnant l'entreprise sur l'ere du AI-Native Build au-dela de son socle d'ingenierie historique.
stories.story_en: In Q4 and full year 2025, EPAM highlights the scaling and acceleration of its AI-native revenues, positioning the company for the AI-Native Build era on top of its core engineering DNA.
stories.signal: We are pleased to deliver a strong fourth quarter and full year 2025, notably scaling and accelerating our AI-native revenues.

stories.short: Succession du fondateur a la direction
stories.story_fr: EPAM a organise une transition de direction : le fondateur principal Arkadiy Dobkin devient President executif et Balazs Fejes prend les fonctions de Directeur General et President a compter du 1er septembre 2025.
stories.story_en: EPAM executed a planned leadership succession: principal founder Arkadiy Dobkin becomes Executive Chairman while Balazs Fejes takes over as CEO and President, effective September 1, 2025.
stories.signal: Principal Founder and CEO Arkadiy Dobkin to Become Executive Chairman Balazs Fejes Appointed to Become President and Chief Executive Officer Succession to be Effective on September 1, 2025

stories.short: Retour a une croissance organique soutenue
stories.story_fr: EPAM enchaine plusieurs trimestres de croissance organique sequentielle a devise constante, marquant un retour a une plus grande regularite de la performance apres une periode plus heurtee.
stories.story_en: EPAM has strung together multiple quarters of sequential organic constant currency revenue growth, marking a return to greater consistency in performance.
stories.signal: We re pleased with another strong quarter of sequential organic growth our third in a row marking a return to greater consistency in our performance.
